remarks: Experience luxury living in this exquisitely renovated 2 bedroom 2 bathroom condo at Mill River House. Enter into an updated kitchen with stunning new quartz countertops, beautiful subway backsplash and stainless steel appliances. Hardwood floors throughout. Both bathrooms have been elegantly redesigned. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, a freshly painted interior, and a cozy mantle with a fireplace that adds modern sophistication. Both spacious bedrooms feature walk-in closets, and the private deck offers direct exterior access. The unit includes a smart-enabled thermostat and security system for added comfort and peace of mind. Residents can take advantage of the on-site fitness center and shared club room. With two dedicated parking garage spaces, this condo is ideally situated near shops, fine dining, I-95, and the train station.
